title: DLQ replay tool for the mail ingress from the raw archive
description: A failed ingress invocation lands in the function dead-letter queue with the event and the error, and the raw message stays in the archive for 30 days. Build an operator tool that replays a dead-lettered receipt event (or a raw archive key) through the ingress handler idempotently, and a runbook entry for it. Found in the PR 648 review.
